summary: Tested new Competitor Ad Intel feature end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 pytest tests pass (auth required, validation for missing text+image, successful Claude analysis with full JSON structure, list, delete). Frontend E2E via Playwright: logged in as admin, opened ABC HVAC client, navigated to Ad Intel tab, submitted competitor text, Claude returned a full analysis card within ~25s showing Their breakdown, How we win, Recommended ad copy, and Higgsfield prompt with Generate image/video buttons. Clicking Generate image produced the expected graceful inline out-of-credits error without crashing the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1016 lines — consider splitting into routers (ads, creatives, clients, auth) for maintainability.
AdIntel component re-fetches list on every clientId change and after each analyze — fine for now, but consider optimistic append to avoid extra roundtrip.
Competitor analysis endpoint blocks on a 10-25s Claude call synchronously; if traffic grows, consider background job pattern like media_jobs.
seed_data_creation: Test created one competitor analysis under ABC HVAC via UI (TEST_UICompetitor) and one via API (TEST_CompetitorAC, deleted at end of pytest run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Competitor Ad Intel feature fully validated (backend + frontend). Higgsfield Generate flow correctly surfaces out-of-credits inline error. No fixes required.
